reference.selection_rule: x-ray; PDBe 2D topology available; natural species; >=95% matched residues with coordinates; model coverage >= family median; best resolution

method.algorithm: Kabsch (SVD) rigid-body superposition, rotation + translation, no scaling, reflections rejected (det R = +1)
method.atom_fallback: per pair: first atom present in both residues in the order C4', P, C1'
method.coordinates: first model (pdbx_PDB_model_num) and first alternate location of the PDBe updated mmCIF
method.pair_selection: same Rfam consensus position, match state in both chains, coordinates in both, PP '*' (>= 0.95) in both; relaxed to PP >= '9' (>= 0.85) when fewer than 10 pairs; transform omitted below 6 pairs
method.quality_bands: good: rmsd <= 2.0 A and >= 20 pairs; moderate: rmsd <= 4.0 A; poor: otherwise; insufficient: < 6 pairs
method.convention: x_ref = R @ x_target + t (column vectors); rotation row-major 3x3; Mol*: Mat4.ofRows([[R00,R01,R02,t0],[R10,R11,R12,t1],[R20,R21,R22,t2],[0,0,0,1]]) with TransformStructureConformation (transpose false); the target structure is moved into the reference frame
